evidence_plan.requirement: Comparison of pivot-based baselines with other methods

payload.reason: The evidence provides sufficient information about pivot-based baselines, their definition, comparisons with other methods, and performance metrics.

claims.text: Pivot-based baselines include traditional transfer learning and multilingual NMT methods.
Pivoting translates from source to pivot and then to target, which is less efficient than direct translation methods.
The proposed methods outperform pivot-based baselines in zero-shot translation scenarios.
